:::{#exm-tuple}
#### Dates as tuples
<!-- no-figure: a few written tuples; nothing to plot -->

A calendar date can be written as a $3$-[tuple](#def-tuple)
(year, month, day),
such as $(2027, 1, 4)$ for 4 January 2027.
The $3$-tuples $(2027, 1, 4)$ and $(2027, 4, 1)$ are not the same,
because their second entries differ,
and they name different days.
An [ordered pair](#def-ordered-pair) is a $2$-tuple.

:::
